svg.text: A FIFO as a ring buffer with two pointers

g.text: push A, B, C: wptr moves on
pop: A leaves, rptr moves on
push D … H: wptr wraps round to slot 0
push I: same slot as rptr, other wrap bit → full
pop 8 times: wptr = rptr again → empty

svg.text: Equal pointers: empty. Same slot but different wrap bit: full.
